purpose: The work packages. Each starts with a PS script and moves through a SEQUENCE of steps, each cross-referenced to its handler. The order lives here — changing it is a config change, not a code change.

new-word.name: Create a new registry word and build its raw layer

sequence.does: stop if the word already exists (a refresh run handles that)
CALL 2 getInfo per strong -> strong + sense + tree + lexicon (the meaning)
CALL 3 per strong -> strong_verse + verse + span (span parsed from preview)
the parse-check: span vs strong_verse must agree

set-candidates.name: Seed + stamp candidate characteristics (span L4b) for a book

sequence.does: refresh candidate_seed over lemma_inventory (independent net + registry-direct + config); recompute registry_match (the double control)
stamp span_candidate on the book's spans whose base-strong is a candidate

build-passages.name: Build passages for a book from the candidate stamp

sequence.does: recompute the book's passages from span_candidate (char-continuity|maximal); flag >review_over as needs_review
